name: Tianjin Jingwei Huikai Optoelectronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Jingwei Huikai Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of liquid crystal display and touch display modules, and electromagnetic wires in China and internationally. It provides S-LCD products, such as party building bulletin board, party building and publicity machine, outdoor guide display board, outdoor guidance and promotional screen, landscape all-in-one query machine, vertical screen query all-in-one machine, outdoor advertising machines, outdoor splicing advertising machines, outdoor electronic water signs, eye-protection display, e-schoolbags, and LCD TV.
